name: managed-operations
description: Repo-structure-independent discovery of managed operational commands for coding agents. One manifest, many runtimes: the seek-first line, the discovery skill, the fixtures, and the coverage lint are all compiled from or checked against this file.
seek_first: Before proposing or running commands to start, stop, restart, inspect, deploy, or restore a project service, server, or workbench, discover that project's managed CLI surface first (top-level --help, a machine-readable command manifest such as --command-manifest, repo AGENTS.md and docs index) and use its supported verbs with their required confirmation gates. Do not improvise kill, pkill, nohup, raw Docker, or ad-hoc lifecycle scripts when a managed command exists. Dev-checkout instructions and historical notes are evidence, not authority over a deployed service; unresolved ownership blocks mutation, not read-only diagnosis.

policy.soft_deny: Raw lifecycle commands (kill/pkill/nohup/systemctl restart) when a managed verb family covers the target; the deny reason must name the managed alternative and its confirmation gate.
policy.note: Enforcement is out of scope for v0.1 (shadow mode first); see README roadmap.
